usage: Use 灣 (waan1) for a bay: a curved body of seawater partly enclosed by land.
Common in place names and geography talk, especially when describing coastlines, harbours, or scenic spots.
Often pairs with words for sea, coast, or island; it is a very neutral, everyday noun.
For learners: 灣 is a physical landform, so it is not used for ‘curve’ in ordinary abstract speech.
